botcomponent.description: Use when the user asks to email a report, findings, or metrics to someone as a polished, newsletter-style message. Builds an Outlook-safe HTML email from figures that already exist (headline, KPI tiles, up to two bar charts drawn with HTML table cells so they render in classic Outlook, Gmail and dark mode, short findings, data notes and the non-audit disclaimer) using the shared brand tokens, attaches the PDF report, and creates a draft for the user to review. Do NOT use for a short plain-text status update, or for building the underlying analysis, charts, or report itself -- this skill only composes the email.
botcomponent.name: newsletter-style-email-composer
